# Nonreciprocity_Threshold

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The condition or parameter regime under which a system's response becomes direction-dependent, breaking time-reversal symmetry in signal propagation. Determines when topological protection or routing advantages emerge in nonreciprocal networks, guiding design of directional signal flow in TCC architectures.
